A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same TRUST study. All 19 pages of v1 and 21 pages of v2, including appendices, are readable, and corresponding methods, equations, tables, and figures can be matched.

before.justification: v1 reports original classification experiments, ablations, computational measurements, and segmentation results, including Tables 1–8 and Figures 2–13.

after.justification: v2 retains those original experiments and reports additional stage-specific latency measurements in Appendix O and TRUST runtime relative to Tent in Table 10.

M1.justification: Sections 3.2–3.3 and Algorithms 1–2 retain entropy-based traversal selection, pseudo-label cross-entropy adaptation of SS2D parameters, parameter averaging, and default-traversal inference. The added robust-risk motivation does not change the implemented objective or procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same seven classification benchmarks and the Pascal VOC21 and Pascal Context59 segmentation datasets. ImageNet-Sketch becomes ImageNet-S in some passages, without changing the represented dataset. No new domain or task is evaluated.

E2.justification: Table 10 adds DPCore as an indirect runtime comparator, placing its literature-reported 1.8× Tent latency alongside TRUST's reported 3.2×. This is not a matched accuracy evaluation. The existing ETA, LAME, SAR, SHOT, Tent, and appendix FOA comparisons remain unchanged.

E3.justification: v2 retains v1's batch-size-1 timing and adds measurements at batch size 128, separate adaptation/averaging/evaluation timings, and Tent-normalized runtime for K=2. These extend the timing evaluation; existing accuracy protocols, data splits, and training settings remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Appendices O–P extend the computational analysis with offline-search cost, stage-specific latency, and relative runtime. Existing accuracy ablations, traversal-entropy analysis, and weight-diversity analysis remain unchanged. Table 9 redisplays the existing K=2 results rather than introducing another ablation.

E5.justification: Neither version adds accuracy-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The means and standard deviations across six traversal-adapted models in the weight-diversity analysis and Figures 12–13 are retained unchanged.

E6.justification: Existing tabulated and plotted results remain unchanged. New results include 1.2 seconds per adaptation permutation at batch size 128 and K=2 runtime of 3.2× Tent. The prose changes the ImageNet-C elastic-corruption gain from 193% to 19.3%, although Table 1 implies 13.0 percentage points. Appendix P also asserts a 1.6% advantage over DPCore without supporting accuracy results.

T1.justification: Equation 1 corrects the preliminary SSM formulation from a discrete recurrence to h'(t)=Ah(t)+Bx(t), preceding the existing discretization. New Equation 11 defines worst-case empirical risk within a parameter neighborhood. Appendix N supplies conceptual reasoning, not a new theorem or proof.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same central contributions: architecture-specific TTA for vision SSMs, confident traversal selection with parameter averaging, and improved robustness across seven classification benchmarks. The added discussions do not redefine these contributions.

C2.justification: Sections 6–7 expand beyond the retained medical-domain caveat by explicitly identifying incompatibility with unmodified CNNs/ViTs and possible reinforcement of pseudo-label errors. Appendices N–O elaborate confidence as a proxy for flatness and argue that selected traversals can be reused across datasets, without adding direct validation of that reuse.

D1.justification: Appendices M–O document forward-only offline search, model reuse and fixed search memory, and stage-specific timing at batch size 128. They also discuss performing traversal selection once for reuse. Existing pseudocode, optimization settings, fine-tuning details, hardware, and code-access information remain unchanged.

R1.justification: v2 adds Model Soups and DPCore citations and discusses their relationship to TRUST. It replaces the physical audiovisual commonsense PACS reference with the visual domain-generalization paper. SWAD was already cited; removing its duplicate bibliography entry does not remove prior-work coverage.

P1.justification: v2 makes localized language and naming corrections, updates the conference footer, adds Limitations and Societal Impact sections, and separates existing appendix topics into lettered sections before adding new discussions. Most original prose and its ordering remain intact.

P2.justification: v2 adds Tables 9–10; Table 9 combines previously reported K=2 and baseline accuracies. All 13 existing figures retain their graphics, with some relocation or resizing. Several appendix tables gain stronger TRUST-row formatting, and section expansion changes page layout.

improvement.justification: v2 corrects the preliminary SSM equation and PACS citation, states architectural and pseudo-label limitations more clearly, and provides useful runtime details while preserving the original empirical evidence. These are limited improvements in clarity and transparency. The benefit is tempered by Appendix N's unproved confidence-to-flatness argument and Appendix P's unsupported 1.6% advantage over DPCore.
